description: Advisory native event POST and captured entity-presence checks on the independently published try.engine.adglare.net host at exact /event. Populated data query carriers use a separate generic loader fallback and are excluded. Tokens, MIME and body encoding remain opaque; /event/{token}, other tenants, native ad requests and current receiver acceptance are outside this profile.

params.name: method
params.description: The native guide explicitly instructs a POST to /event with its event token as payload.

params.name: body_encoding
params.description: Only none means this complete capture supplies no entity. No MIME or decoded token schema is inferred.

params.name: entity_body_bytes
params.description: When explicit binary capture metadata is available, zero entity bytes cannot contain the documented event token. Raw-token grammar and native JSON shape are not checked.

rules.message: The native event guide includes an event-token payload. This complete capture supplies no entity.
